name: Tegau Eurfron

attributes.attribute: one of the Three Splendid Women of Camelot
saved her husband from a venomous snake
gained a breast made of gold to match her golden hair

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tegau Eurfron is a Welsh heroine. She ranked among the Three Splendid Women of Camelot. She saved her husband from a venomous snake. The snake bit her. She lost one breast because of it. She then had a breast made of gold. The gold matched her golden hair.

okr.objective: Describe the Welsh heroine Tegau Eurfron.
key_results: She was one of the Three Splendid Women of Camelot.
She saved her husband from a venomous snake.
She lost a breast after a snakebite and gained a breast made of gold.
